```{r author and site information}
## unit conversion constants
```

```{r Config-Validate}
# Validate configuration before writing anything.
stopifnot(
   nrow(sites) > 0, nrow(projections) > 0,
   !anyDuplicated(sites$site_id), !anyDuplicated(projections$projection_id),
   all(is.finite(sites$site_x)), all(is.finite(sites$site_y)),
   all(abs(sites$site_y) <= 90), all(abs(sites$site_x) <= 360)
)
ids <- c(sites$site_id, projections$projection_id)
if (any(is.na(ids) | !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$", ids))) {
   stop("Use nonempty site/projection IDs containing letters, numbers, _, - or .")
}
for (j in seq_len(nrow(projections))) {
   if (!dir.exists(projections$in_path[j])) stop("Missing input directory: ", projections$in_path[j])
   if (!file.exists(projections$wrfxy_path[j])) stop("Missing coordinate file: ", projections$wrfxy_path[j])
   if (!length(list.files(projections$in_path[j], pattern = "\\.nc$"))) {
      stop("No .nc inputs in ", projections$in_path[j])
   }
}
```

```{r Helper-Functions}
read_grid <- function(path) {
   nc <- nc_open(path)
   on.exit(nc_close(nc))
   lon <- ncvar_get(nc, "LONGXY", collapse_degen = FALSE)
   lat <- ncvar_get(nc, "LATIXY", collapse_degen = FALSE)
   if (length(dim(lon)) != 2 || !identical(dim(lon), dim(lat))) {
      stop("Expected matching 2-D LONGXY and LATIXY in ", path)
   }
   list(lon = lon, lat = lat)
}

nearest_cell <- function(grid, lon, lat) {
   # Great-circle distance ranking; paired coordinates avoid ambiguous matches.
   dlon <- ((grid$lon - lon + 180) %% 360 - 180) * pi / 180
   a <- sin((grid$lat - lat) * pi / 360)^2 +
      cos(lat * pi / 180) * cos(grid$lat * pi / 180) * sin(dlon / 2)^2
   a[!is.finite(a)] <- Inf
   if (!any(is.finite(a))) stop("Coordinate grid has no valid cells")
   as.integer(arrayInd(which.min(a), dim(grid$lon))[1, ])
}

read_site <- function(path, ij, grid) {
   nc <- nc_open(path)
   on.exit(nc_close(nc))
   times <- ncvar_get(nc, "time")
   unit_now <- ncatt_get(nc, "time", "units")
   # if (!isTRUE(unit_now$hasatt)) stop("Missing time units in ", path)
   # calendar <- ncatt_get(nc, "time", "calendar")
   # calendar <- if (isTRUE(calendar$hasatt)) calendar$value else "noleap"
   calendar <- "noleap"
   wanted <- unique(c(varinfo$vfates, "EBOT", "RBOT"))
   available <- intersect(wanted, names(nc$var))
   df <- as_tibble(matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(times), ncol = 0))
   for (v in available) {
      dims <- nc$var[[v]]$dim
      # Explicitly check the original [x,y,time] layout before indexing.
      if (length(dims) != 3 ||
         !identical(as.integer(vapply(dims[1:2], function(d) d$len, numeric(1))), as.integer(dim(grid$lon))) ||
         dims[[3]]$name != "time" || dims[[3]]$len != length(times)) {
         stop("Expected [x,y,time] on the reference grid for ", v, " in ", path)
      }
      df[[v]] <- as.vector(ncvar_get(nc, v, start = c(ij, 1), count = c(1, 1, -1)))
   }
   required <- c("PSRF", "TBOT", "WIND", "FSDS", "PRECTmms", "FLDS")
   missing <- setdiff(required, names(df))
   if (length(missing)) stop("Missing variables in ", path, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
   if (!any(c("QBOT", "RH", "EBOT", "RBOT") %in% names(df))) {
      stop("No humidity variable in ", path)
   }
   list(df = df, times = times, units = unit_now$value, calendar = calendar)
}
```

```{r Write-Monthly-File}
write_site_month <- function(input, file_now, site, projection, ij, grid) {
   site_x <- site$site_x
   site_y <- site$site_y
   site_desc <- site$site_id
   dat_version <- projection$dat_version
   metd_path <- file.path(projection$out_path, site$site_id, "CLM1PT_data")
   df_now <- input$df
   times <- input$times
   unit_now <- input$units
   calendar <- input$calendar
   dim_t <- length(times)
   outprec <- -floor(log10(dxy * 0.01))

   # Standardise coordinates (and make sure latitude cannot exceed the poles).
   outlon <- round(site_x, outprec) %% 360.
   outlat <- max(-90, min(90 - 0.5 * dxy, round(site_y, outprec)))

   # Find edges.
   edge_w <- (outlon - 0.5 * dxy) %% 360.
   edge_e <- (outlon + 0.5 * dxy) %% 360.
   edge_s <- outlat - 0.5 * dxy
   edge_n <- outlat + 0.5 * dxy

   print(outlon)
   print(outlat)
   # Define the template.  We will update the title in each time step.
   att_template <- list(
      title          = "To be replaced when looping through months",
      version        = dat_version,
      date_created   = paste0(as.character(now(tzone = "UTC")), "UTC"),
      source_code    = "WRF-driver-subsetting.ipynb",
      code_notes     = "Meteorological drivers compatible with ELM-FATES and CLM-FATES",
      code_developer = paste0(author_name, " <", author_email, ">"),
      data_provider  = paste0(datprov_name, " <", datprov_email, ">"),
      usage_notes    = data_usage_notes
   ) # end list
   ## add RH
   if ("QBOT" %in% names(df_now)) {
      # Specific humidity already in the meteorological driver, find relative humidity.
      cat(" - Specific humidity included in the input data. Find relative humidity")
      df_now <- df_now %>%
         mutate(
            EBOT = PSRF * QBOT / (eps_mol + (1. - eps_mol) * QBOT),
            ESAT = esat_0C * exp(17.67 * (TBOT - degC_2_K) / (TBOT - 29.65)),
            RH   = frac_2_pc * EBOT / ESAT
         ) %>%
         select(!c(EBOT, ESAT)) %>%
         mutate(RH = ifelse(RH > 100, 100, RH))
   } else if ("RH" %in% names(df_now)) {
      # Find specific humidity from vapour pressure
      df_now <- df_now %>%
         mutate(
            ESAT = esat_0C * exp(17.67 * (TBOT - degC_2_K) / (TBOT - 29.65)),
            EBOT = pc_2_frac * RH * ESAT,
            QBOT = eps_mol * EBOT / (PSRF - (1. - eps_mol) * EBOT)
         ) %>%
         select(!c(ESAT, EBOT))
   } else if ("EBOT" %in% names(df_now)) {
      # Find specific humidity from vapour pressure
      df_now <- df_now %>%
         mutate(
            QBOT = eps_mol * EBOT / (PSRF - (1. - eps_mol) * EBOT),
            ESAT = esat_0C * exp(17.67 * (TBOT - degC_2_K) / (TBOT - 29.65)),
            RH   = frac_2_pc * EBOT / ESAT
         ) %>%
         select(!c(ESAT))
   } else {
      # Find specific humidity from mixing ratio
      df_now <- df_now %>%
         mutate(
            QBOT = RBOT / (1. + RBOT),
            EBOT = PSRF * QBOT / (eps_mol + (1. - eps_mol) * QBOT),
            ESAT = esat_0C * exp(17.67 * (TBOT - degC_2_K) / (TBOT - 29.65)),
            RH   = frac_2_pc * EBOT / ESAT
         ) %>%
         select(!c(EBOT, ESAT))
   }


   ## add observation height
   if (!("ZBOT" %in% names(df_now))) df_now$ZBOT <- rep(site_refhgt, dim_t)


   ## write out file
   nc_base <- file_now
   final_file <- file.path(metd_path, nc_base)
   nc_file <- paste0(final_file, ".partial")
   if (file.exists(nc_file)) unlink(nc_file)
   cat(" + Write output: ", nc_base, "\n", sep = "")

   xx <- ncdim_def(name = "lon", units = "", vals = 1L, create_dimvar = FALSE)
   yy <- ncdim_def(name = "lat", units = "", vals = 1L, create_dimvar = FALSE)
   tt <- ncdim_def(name = "time", units = "", vals = seq_along(times), create_dimvar = FALSE)
   ss <- ncdim_def(name = "scalar", units = "", vals = 1L, create_dimvar = FALSE)

   # List of dimensions, useful for setting variables.
   nc_xy <- list(xx, yy)
   nc_xyt <- list(xx, yy, tt)
   nc_t <- list(tt)
   nc_s <- list(ss)
   xy <- c(1, 1)
   xyt <- c(1, 1, dim_t)

   # Start list with variables. First we put the coordinates
   nc_vlist <- list()
   nc_vlist$LONGXY <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "LONGXY",
      units    = "degrees_east",
      dim      = nc_xy,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "longitude"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$LATIXY <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "LATIXY",
      units    = "degrees_north",
      dim      = nc_xy,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "latitude"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$EDGEW <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "EDGEW",
      units    = "degrees_east",
      dim      = nc_s,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "western edge in atmospheric data"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$EDGEE <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "EDGEE",
      units    = "degrees_east",
      dim      = nc_s,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "eastern edge in atmospheric data"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$EDGES <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "EDGES",
      units    = "degrees_north",
      dim      = nc_s,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "southern edge in atmospheric data"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$EDGEN <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "EDGEN",
      units    = "degrees_north",
      dim      = nc_s,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "northern edge in atmospheric data"
   ) # end ncvar_def
   nc_vlist$time <- ncvar_def(
      name     = "time",
      units    = unit_now,
      dim      = nc_t,
      missval  = undef,
      longname = "WRF model time"
   ) # end ncvar_def

   # Loop through FATES met drivers, add them
   for (v in seq_along(varinfo[[1]])) {
      # Handy shorter names
      v_vfates <- varinfo$vfates[v]
      v_vlname <- varinfo$vlname[v]
      v_vunits <- varinfo$vunits[v]

      # Add variable information
      nc_vlist[[v_vfates]] <- ncvar_def(
         name     = v_vfates,
         units    = v_vunits,
         dim      = nc_xyt,
         missval  = undef,
         longname = v_vlname
      ) # end ncvar_def
   } # end for (v in seq_along(varinfo[[1]]))

   # Create file
   nc_conn <- nc_create(filename = nc_file, vars = nc_vlist, verbose = FALSE)
   on.exit(try(nc_close(nc_conn), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
   # on.exit(nc_close(nc_conn), add=TRUE)

   #---~---
   # Put coordinates, tower height and attributes to the netcdf
   #---~---
   # Longitude, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "LONGXY", vals = array(data = outlon, dim = xy))
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "LONGXY", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Latitude, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "LATIXY", vals = array(data = outlat, dim = xy))
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "LATIXY", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Western edge, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEW", vals = edge_w)
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEW", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Eastern edge, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEE", vals = edge_e)
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEE", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Southern edge, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGES", vals = edge_s)
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGES", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Northern edge, append time-invariant tag
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEN", vals = edge_n)
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "EDGEN", attname = "mode", attval = "time-invariant")
   # Time, append calendar type.
   dummy <- ncvar_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "time", vals = times)
   dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = "time", attname = "calendar", attval = calendar) # preserve input calendar
   #---~---

   # Put variables to the netcdf
   for (v in seq_along(varinfo[[1]])) {
      # Handy shorter names
      v_vfates <- varinfo$vfates[v]
      v_vlname <- varinfo$vlname[v]
      v_vunits <- varinfo$vunits[v]


      # Add variable information
      dummy <- ncvar_put(
         nc    = nc_conn,
         varid = v_vfates,
         vals  = array(data = df_now[[v_vfates]], dim = xyt)
      ) # end ncvar_put

      # Add attribute to highlight this is time-dependent
      dummy <- ncatt_put(
         nc      = nc_conn,
         varid   = v_vfates,
         attname = "mode",
         attval  = "time-dependent"
      )
   } # end for (v in seq_along(varinfo[[1]]))

   # Add title specific for this month/year.
   nc_title <- paste0("Meteorological forcing for ", site_desc, " (", file_now, ")")
   att_global <- modifyList(x = att_template, val = list(title = nc_title))


   # Loop through global attributes
   for (l in seq_along(att_global)) {
      # Current attribute information
      att_name <- names(att_global)[l]
      att_value <- att_global[[l]]

      # Add attribute
      dummy <- ncatt_put(nc = nc_conn, varid = 0, attname = att_name, attval = att_value)
   } # end for (l in seq_along(att_global))

   nc_close(nc_conn)
   on.exit(NULL) # File is already closed.
   if (!file.rename(nc_file, final_file)) {
      stop("Could not rename completed file: ", nc_file)
   }


   # Close the file
   # Closed by on.exit, including if writing fails.
}
```





```{r Parallel-Processing-HPC}
# Run this notebook inside a single-node HPC allocation.
# Set this no higher than the CPU cores requested for that allocation.
n_cores <- 8L

run_parallel_subsetting <- function(n_cores) {
   stopifnot(
      length(n_cores) == 1L, is.finite(n_cores),
      n_cores >= 1L, n_cores == as.integer(n_cores)
   )
   n_workers <- min(as.integer(n_cores), nrow(sites))
   cat(sprintf(
      "Using %d workers for %d sites × %d projections\n",
      n_workers, nrow(sites), nrow(projections)
   ))

   # PSOCK uses independent R sessions, including in a Jupyter R kernel.
   # No open NetCDF handles are shared between workers.
   cl <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(n_workers)
   on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
   parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      library(ncdf4)
      library(lubridate)
      library(tidyverse)
      NULL
   })
   parallel::clusterExport(cl, c(
      "sites", "site_refhgt", "skip_existing", "read_site", "write_site_month",
      "varinfo", "dxy", "undef", "eps_mol", "esat_0C", "degC_2_K",
      "frac_2_pc", "pc_2_frac", "author_name", "author_email",
      "datprov_name", "datprov_email", "data_usage_notes"
   ), envir = .GlobalEnv)

   process_site <- function(i) {
      site <- sites[i, ]
      ij <- indices[[i]]
      output_dir <- file.path(projection$out_path, site$site_id, "CLM1PT_data")
      log_file <- file.path(output_dir, "subsetting.log")
      # Redirect verbose writer output to a separate log for each site.
      sink(log_file, append = TRUE)
      on.exit(sink(), add = TRUE)
      cat("\nStarted:", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
      cat(sprintf(
         "%s / %s: cell [%d,%d], lon=%.6f, lat=%.6f\n",
         projection$projection_id, site$site_id, ij[1], ij[2],
         grid$lon[ij[1], ij[2]], grid$lat[ij[1], ij[2]]
      ))
      written <- 0L
      skipped <- 0L
      tryCatch(
         {
            for (file_now in files) {
               output <- file.path(output_dir, file_now)
               if (file.exists(output)) {
                  if (skip_existing) {
                     skipped <- skipped + 1L
                     next
                  }
                  stop(
                     "Output already exists: ", output,
                     ". Set skip_existing=TRUE to skip completed files."
                  )
               }
               cat("Processing:", file_now, "\n")
               input <- read_site(file.path(projection$in_path, file_now), ij, grid)
               write_site_month(input, file_now, site, projection, ij, grid)
               written <- written + 1L
            }
            cat("Finished:", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
            list(
               site = site$site_id, ok = TRUE, written = written, skipped = skipped,
               error = "", log = log_file
            )
         },
         error = function(e) {
            cat("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
            list(
               site = site$site_id, ok = FALSE, written = written, skipped = skipped,
               error = conditionMessage(e), log = log_file
            )
         }
      )
   }
   # Avoid serializing the master's environment (which contains the cluster).
   environment(process_site) <- .GlobalEnv

   for (j in seq_len(nrow(projections))) {
      projection <- projections[j, ]
      grid <- read_grid(projection$wrfxy_path)
      files <- sort(list.files(projection$in_path, pattern = "\\.nc$"))
      indices <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sites)), function(i) {
         nearest_cell(grid, sites$site_x[i], sites$site_y[i])
      })
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(sites))) {
         dir.create(file.path(projection$out_path, sites[i, ]$site_id, "CLM1PT_data"),
            recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE
         )
      }
      # Send this projection's grid once per worker, not once per monthly file.
      parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("projection", "grid", "files", "indices"),
         envir = environment()
      )
      cat("Starting projection:", projection$projection_id, "\n")
      # Load balancing gives another site to each worker as it becomes available.
      results <- parallel::parLapplyLB(cl, seq_len(nrow(sites)), process_site,
         chunk.size = 1L
      )
      for (r in results) {
         cat(sprintf(
            "%s / %s: %s; %d written, %d skipped\n",
            projection$projection_id, r$site,
            if (r$ok) "complete" else "FAILED", r$written, r$skipped
         ))
      }
      failed <- Filter(function(r) !r$ok, results)
      if (length(failed)) {
         for (r in failed) cat(r$site, ": ", r$error, "\nLog: ", r$log, "\n", sep = "")
         stop("Some sites failed; see the logs above before resuming.")
      }
   }
   cat("All site/projection combinations completed.\n")
   invisible(NULL)
}

run_parallel_subsetting(n_cores)
```
